A loan whose instalment of principal and interest amount has remained overdue for a period of 180 days.

Assess the profitability and size of the company
Determine the size and composition of the assets and liabilities of the company
Determine the market share, debts and assets of the company

q: The main reason for inflation is
explanation: Deficit budgets (deficit financing) expand money supply and demand, a main cause of inflation; 'increase in prices' is inflation itself, not its cause, and over-production lowers prices. (Printed key: increase in prices.)

q: Increase in aggregate demand is the main cause for
explanation: Demand-pull inflation arises when aggregate demand exceeds aggregate supply, so a rise in aggregate demand is its main cause; cost-push comes from rising input costs.

q: The excess of aggregate demand over aggregate supply at full employment relates to
explanation: Aggregate demand exceeding aggregate supply at full-employment output is the inflationary gap, the situation behind demand-pull inflation.

notes.text: - **Inflationary gap**: excess of aggregate demand (spending) over aggregate supply at **full-employment** output.

q: Prices in India increase mainly not because of
explanation: Hoarding, oil price shocks and lower agricultural production are standard causes of price rise in India (NextGen lists all three), so the odd one is the vague 'indiscriminate increase in public expectations'. (Printed key: less agricultural production – but that is a main supply-side cause.)

q: Inflation is caused by
explanation: Inflation results from more money (demand) chasing fewer goods: a rise in money supply and a fall in production both cause it, so (1) and (3). (Moved to inflation.)

notes.text: - General price rise may come from **more money supply**, **lower aggregate output** and **higher effective demand** (UPSC 2013: all three).

q: The cause of inflation is
options: Increase in money supply and fall in production
Decrease in money supply and fall in Production
key_text: Increase in money supply and fall in production
explanation: Inflation is caused by excess demand – more money supply – together with a fall in production (less supply), so the combined option. (Moved to inflation.)

notes.text: - General price rise may come from **more money supply**, **lower aggregate output** and **higher effective demand** (UPSC 2013: all three).
